# dsh-git-graph

> Read-only Git Graph sidebar for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web, by WhitePlusMS: commit history, branches and tags, file diffs, two-commit comparison, and complete historical file source — inside DSH's native right sidebar, with no API key and no conversation message.
>
> DSH 原生右侧栏的只读 Git 可视化插件：提交历史、分支与标签、文件 Diff、两提交比较、完整历史原文。无需 API Key，也不占用对话消息。

- Repository: https://github.com/WhitePlusMS/dsh-git-graph
- Latest release (0.5.3, 2026-10-21): https://github.com/WhitePlusMS/dsh-git-graph/releases/tag/v0.5.3
- Install archive: https://github.com/WhitePlusMS/dsh-git-graph/releases/download/v0.5.3/dsh-git-graph-0.5.3.tgz
- Changelog: https://github.com/WhitePlusMS/dsh-git-graph/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md
- English README: https://github.com/WhitePlusMS/dsh-git-graph/blob/master/README.md
- Chinese README: https://github.com/WhitePlusMS/dsh-git-graph/blob/master/README.zh.md

## Install

Requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.2, the `dsh` CLI, pnpm, and Git on the DSH Host. Installation is from the GitHub Release archive, not from npm:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/WhitePlusMS/dsh-git-graph/releases/download/v0.5.3/dsh-git-graph-0.5.3.tgz
```

Restart the same DSH Web instance afterwards, then open **dsh-git-graph** from the right sidebar.

## Facts

- Name: `dsh-git-graph` (package name and DSH bundle row id).
- Author and maintainer: WhitePlusMS.
- License: MIT.
- UI languages: Chinese and English.
- Compatible runtime: DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.
- Data source: the current session workspace's local Git repository only.
- Operations: read-only. The plugin never writes to the repository, the index, refs, or the remote.
- Distribution: GitHub Releases (`*.tgz` with prebuilt `lib/`), checksummed with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Not published to npm.

## What it does

- Renders commit topology with branch/tag/HEAD references; every reference is shown and wraps instead of collapsing into `+N`.
- Inline commit details: author and committer dates, parents, references, signature status, copy actions.
- File changes per commit with tree or list view, per-file unified diff, and a working-tree (uncommitted changes) view.
- Two-commit comparison: pick a base commit, then open each changed file's unified diff.
- Historical file source: read and copy the old or new version of a file, up to 1 MiB per file.
- Commit messages with links, bold, italic, and inline code; author avatars from GitHub, Gravatar, or the repository's own Git service (Gitea/Gogs).
- Display settings saved per repository: column widths, date format and source, compact rows, line style, lane palette, reference alignment.

## What it does not do

- No staging, committing, pushing, pulling, fetching, merging, or tag creation.
- No side-by-side diff, syntax highlighting, tag signature verification, or stash diffs.
- No remote hosting API calls, except the optional avatar lookups described above; disabling avatars stops them.

## Not this project

- The npm package named `dsh-git-graph` (author `enoughpower`, latest 0.1.8) is a **different plugin** that includes write features. This project is installed from the GitHub Release archive above.
- Other DSH Git plugins use similar names, for example `kp-z/dsh-dev-git-graph`, `lengmoXXL/dsh-git`, `EasyTZ/dsh-git`, and `LeonZ666/dsh-gitworktree-gui`. They are independent projects, not maintained here.
